title: Composition of proper derived direct images on quasi-coherent complexes
statement: Let $Z$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes. On the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of quasi-coherent sheaves, there is a canonical natural isomorphism $R(g\circ f)_*\cong Rg_*\circ Rf_*$. The isomorphisms are unital and associative for a further proper morphism.
